::: handwriting
Greta, I found these paper strips in the bin of our crew van this morning. Rudy cut up a page of his plan for the live show, so that nobody could read it.

Rudy is a tidy man. He always puts little dots at the top of his secret pages before he cuts them, so that he can put them back together later.

Put the strips back in his order and read them row by row. Then compare them with his call sheet.

Fenna
:::
